```{r soil-dem-extraction, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 1. Load soil points as sf, specifying original CRS (WGS84: EPSG:4326)
soil_data <- read.csv("../Local Data- DO NOT PUSH/soil_points_corrected.csv")
soil_points <- st_as_sf(soil_data, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 4326)

# 2. Load USGS DEMs and merge
usgs_files <- list.files("../Local Data- DO NOT PUSH/USGS_1m_DEM/", pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
usgs_dems <- lapply(usgs_files, rast)
usgs_dem_merged <- do.call(merge, usgs_dems)
#save as .tif for future use
#writeRaster(usgs_dem_merged, "../Local Data- DO NOT PUSH/USGS_tile.tif", overwrite=TRUE)
# 3. Load drone DEM
drone_dem <- rast("../Local Data- DO NOT PUSH/Bastos_Data/dem/50cm_DEM_processed.tif")
offset <- 26.81743 #mean diff 
drone_dem <- drone_dem + offset

# 4. Reproject both DEMs (if necessary) to match USGS DEM CRS (assumed EPSG:32617)
usgs_crs <- crs(usgs_dem_merged)
if(crs(drone_dem) != usgs_crs) {
  drone_dem <- project(drone_dem, usgs_crs)
}
# Optionally reproject USGS DEM if needed (rare)
# usgs_dem_merged <- project(usgs_dem_merged, "EPSG:32617")

# 5. Reproject soil points to DEM CRS
soil_points_utm <- st_transform(soil_points, crs = usgs_crs)
coords_utm <- st_coordinates(soil_points_utm)

# 6. Resample drone DEM to USGS grid
drone_dem_resampled <- resample(drone_dem, usgs_dem_merged, method = "bilinear")

# 7. Fill NAs in drone DEM with USGS DEM values
drone_dem_filled <- drone_dem_resampled
na_cells <- is.na(drone_dem_filled)
drone_dem_filled[na_cells] <- usgs_dem_merged[na_cells]

#smooth out any artifacts from filling
drone_dem_filled_smooth <- focal(drone_dem_filled, w = matrix(1,3,3), fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
# 8. Save final filled and smoothed DEM
#writeRaster(drone_dem_filled_smooth, "../Local Data- DO NOT PUSH/Bastos_Data/Bastos_DEM_filled_smooth.tif", overwrite=TRUE)
# load in border shp and overlay on DEM
border <- st_read("../Local Data- DO NOT PUSH/Border/border.shp")
border <- st_transform(border, crs = usgs_crs)

#create new box extent around border with a buffer of 10,000m, centering on the border
border_center <- st_centroid(st_union(border))

# Extract center coordinates
center_coords <- st_coordinates(border_center)[1,]
half_size <- 5000  # half of 10,000 m

# Create bounding box as POLYGON
bbox_poly <- st_polygon(list(rbind(
  c(center_coords[1] - half_size, center_coords[2] - half_size),
  c(center_coords[1] - half_size, center_coords[2] + half_size),
  c(center_coords[1] + half_size, center_coords[2] + half_size),
  c(center_coords[1] + half_size, center_coords[2] - half_size),
  c(center_coords[1] - half_size, center_coords[2] - half_size)
)))
bbox_sf <- st_sfc(bbox_poly, crs = st_crs(border))

plot(drone_dem_filled_smooth)
plot(bbox_sf, add=TRUE, border='red', lwd=2)
plot(border, add=TRUE, border='blue', lwd=2)

#crop both DEMs to this new extent
drone_dem_cropped <- crop(drone_dem_filled_smooth, vect(bbox_sf))
usgs_dem_cropped <- crop(usgs_dem_merged, vect(bbox_sf))

#save .tifs:
writeRaster(drone_dem_cropped, "../Local Data- DO NOT PUSH/Bastos_Data/dem/Bastos_1m_DEM_cropped.tif", overwrite=TRUE)
writeRaster(usgs_dem_cropped, "../Local Data- DO NOT PUSH/USGS_1m_DEM/USGS_1m_DEM_cropped.tif", overwrite=TRUE)
#plot cropped DEMs
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
plot(drone_dem_cropped, main="Drone DEM (1m) - Cropped")
plot(usgs_dem_cropped, main="USGS DEM (1m) - Cropped")
```

```{r raster comparison function}
library(terra)

compare_rasters <- function(..., tol = 1e-6) {
  rasters <- list(...)
  
  if (!all(sapply(rasters, inherits, "SpatRaster"))) {
    stop("All inputs must be 'SpatRaster' objects.")
  }
  
  ref <- rasters[[1]]
  
  # Helper to compare numeric vectors with tolerance
  equal_num <- function(a, b, tol) all(abs(a - b) < tol)
  
  # Compare resolution, CRS, and extent
  res_check <- sapply(rasters, function(x) equal_num(res(x), res(ref), tol))
  crs_check <- sapply(rasters, function(x) crs(x) == crs(ref))
  ext_check <- sapply(rasters, function(x) {
    e1 <- as.vector(ext(x))
    e2 <- as.vector(ext(ref))
    equal_num(e1, e2, tol)
  })
  
  summary <- data.frame(
    Raster = paste0("Raster_", seq_along(rasters)),
    Resolution_Match = res_check,
    CRS_Match = crs_check,
    Extent_Match = ext_check
  )
  
  all_match <- all(res_check) && all(crs_check) && all(ext_check)
  
  cat("\n--- Raster Comparison Summary ---\n")
  print(summary, row.names = FALSE)
  
  if (all_match) {
    cat("\n✅ All rasters have the same resolution, CRS, and extent.\n")
  } else {
    cat("\n⚠️  Some rasters differ in one or more attributes.\n")
  }
  
  invisible(summary)
}


```

```{r}
library(terra)
library(randomForest)

# --- 1. Load / assume you already have these (aligned to same 3m grid) ---
# planet_bare_soil_2025   # SpatRaster with bands: blue, green, red, rededge, nir
# bastos_multispec_stack  # SpatRaster with bands: blue, green, red, rededge, nir

# --- 2. Rename layers to avoid ambiguous/duplicated names ---
names(bastos_multispec_stack) <- paste0("ms_", names(bastos_multispec_stack))
names(planet_bare_soil_2025) <- paste0("pl_", names(planet_bare_soil_2025))

# quick check
print(names(bastos_multispec_stack))
print(names(planet_bare_soil_2025))

# --- 3. Build combined stack and sample only locations with valid paired data ---
combo <- c(bastos_multispec_stack, planet_bare_soil_2025)


set.seed(42)
# sample only where both have data (na.rm = TRUE)
train_df <- spatSample(combo, size = 30000, method = "random", as.df = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)

# inspect column names in the training dataframe to be sure
head(names(train_df))
# make sure target and predictor columns are present, e.g. "ms_blue", "pl_blue", ...

# --- 4. Train per-band random forest (Planet predictors -> Bastos target) ---
filled_layers <- list()
planet_predictors <- paste0("pl_", c("blue","green","red","rededge","nir"))
target_bands <- c("blue","green","red","rededge","nir")

for(target_base in target_bands) {
  target_col <- paste0("ms_", target_base)   # e.g. "ms_blue"
  # formula uses ms_* as response and pl_* as predictors
  formula_rf <- as.formula(paste(target_col, "~", paste(planet_predictors, collapse = " + ")))

  # Train RF on the sampled dataframe
  rf_mod <- randomForest(formula_rf, data = train_df, ntree = 300, na.action = na.omit)

  # Predict across the whole Planet covariate stack (planet_bare_soil_2025 has pl_ names)
  preds <- predict(planet_bare_soil_2025, rf_mod,
                   filename = paste0("pred_ms_", target_base, ".tif"),
                   overwrite = TRUE, progress = TRUE)

  # Take original Bastos band (ms_...) and fill NA values with the prediction
  orig_band <- bastos_multispec_stack[[paste0("ms_", target_base)]]
  filled_band <- cover(orig_band, preds)  # prefer original where present; otherwise prediction

  filled_layers[[target_base]] <- filled_band
}

# --- 5. Stack filled bands and write out ---
bastos_filled_rf <- rast(filled_layers)
names(bastos_filled_rf) <- target_bands
writeRaster(bastos_filled_rf, "bastos_multispec_filled_rf_3m.tif", overwrite = TRUE)


#plot bastos green against planet green to see relationship from combined stack (include r^2 value and slope value)
plot(combo[["ms_green"]], combo[["pl_green"]], xlab="Bastos Multispec Green", ylab="Planet Bare Soil Green", main="Bastos vs Planet Green Reflectance") 
#get r^2 value
model <- lm(pl_green ~ ms_green, data=as.data.frame(combo, na.rm=TRUE))
r_squared <- summary(model)$r.squared
#add r^2 value to plot
legend("topleft", legend=paste("R² =", round(r_squared, 4)), bty="n")
#add regression line to plot
abline(model, col="red")

#red:
plot(combo[["ms_red"]], combo[["pl_red"]], xlab="Bastos Multispec Red", ylab="Planet Bare Soil Red", main="Bastos vs Planet Red Reflectance") 
#get r^2 value
model_red <- lm(pl_red ~ ms_red, data=as.data.frame(combo, na.rm=TRUE))
r_squared_red <- summary(model_red)$r.squared
#add r^2 value to plot
legend("topleft", legend=paste("R² =", round(r_squared_red, 4)), bty="n")
#add regression line to plot
abline(model_red, col="red")

#blue 
plot(combo[["ms_blue"]], combo[["pl_blue"]], xlab="Bastos Multispec Blue", ylab="Planet Bare Soil Blue", main="Bastos vs Planet Blue Reflectance")
#get r^2 value
model_blue <- lm(pl_blue ~ ms_blue, data=as.data.frame(combo, na.rm=TRUE))
r_squared_blue <- summary(model_blue)$r.squared
#add r^2 value to plot
legend("topleft", legend=paste("R² =", round(r_squared_blue, 4)), bty="n")
#add regression line to plot
abline(model_blue, col="red")
```
